full-width.description:
Distribute the available inline space evenly among all segments. A label
wider than its equal share wraps onto a second line.

label.description: Required accessible name of the group. Use a short name for the setting.

size.description:
Track size. The default heights are 28, 32 and 40 CSS px respectively;
surrounding density settings can increase or decrease targets.

value.description:
Resolved selected value. Set it to choose an option programmatically.
Omit it to select the first available option. The value is empty when
there are no available options. Programmatic changes are silent.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-segment-padding-inline-xs.description: Inline padding of an extra-small segment.

--ki-segmented-control-track-size-md.description: Medium track height before density adjustment.

--ki-segmented-control-track-size-sm.description: Small track height before density adjustment.

--ki-segmented-control-track-size-xs.description: Extra-small track height before density adjustment.

--ki-segmented-radius.description: Corner radius of the control track.

--ki-segmented-track-backdrop-filter.description: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind the track.

--ki-segmented-track-bg.description: Solid surface for the segment track.

--ki-segmented-track-bg-image.description: Optional image layered over the track surface.

--ki-segmented-track-padding.description: Inset between the track and its segments.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: A compact control for one in-place choice among two to five options.

ki-change.description: Emitted once per changed user choice with the new resolved value.

track.description: Surface containing the radiogroup and its options.
